correctness.rationale: The two-variable formula theta(x)=x!=e AND exists y[R(x,x,y) AND R(x,y,e)] detects precisely nonidentity cubic torsion. Squaring is bijective in every odd-order group because each square root lies in the cyclic subgroup generated by its square. For nontrivial order-3 x, square=inverse=square-root; otherwise they are three distinct elements in the same unary category. The resulting exhaustive (I,T,N) pair-atomic profile table has multiplicities determined by n and t; induction on Boolean operations and counting quantification proves all unrestricted quantifier depths. Independent exhaustive atomic-profile tests using all 27 ternary substitutions agreed for C25 vs C5xC5 (n,t)=(25,0) and abelian C3^3 vs nonabelian UT3(F3) (27,26). The finite tests check premises only, not the infinite theorem.
